_note: Named settings for an art style (import.json "profile": name); the map's own settings go over them. Add a profile when a map in a new style imports cleanly. tools/mapimport/build.py with_profile().

thin-lines-grey-stone.note: Thin black wall lines (about 0.05 of a square) on grey or blue tiled floors with a dark grid; doors are white bars drawn on the wall line. Walls are found as straight lines with their thickness; grid lines are suppressed; each keyed room's interior is erased so floor shading never becomes a wall.

thick-stone-parchment.note: Thick dark-brown stone walls traced as outlines (the importer's defaults); outdoor ground, moss and water separated by hue.

thick-dark-timber.note: Thick dark timber or plaster walls (about a quarter of a square, drawn between two black outlines, with a soft drop shadow and square posts at the corners) on plank or flagstone floors over outdoor ground; doors are white bars on the wall line, windows grey bars. The shadow is as dark as the wall, so tracing and measuring both overshoot: every wall is a hand-placed straight line (lines.add with fixed: true, measured outline to outline with tools/mapimport/wallscan.py), nothing is traced, and the mask keeps only the near-black outlines (for door detection). Window detection is off (grey also matches stone floors): list windows by hand.
thick-dark-timber.learned_from: an Adventure Path's village battle maps, about 45 px a square (2026-11-14)
